item.tib: dpal de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa
item.coloph: de kho na nyid ye shes yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba dag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas pa chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gyi zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa paN+Di ta stong nyid de 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po'i A tsar+ya b+ha ren+d+ra ru tse dang / /lo tsA ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o
